name: What role does project management play in safety on the jobsite?
description: The project manager reinforces safety expectations, monitors site conditions, ensures trades follow regulations, and coordinates access so the site remains safe

mainEntity.name: What role does project management play in safety on the jobsite?

acceptedAnswer.text: The project manager reinforces safety expectations, monitors site conditions, ensures trades follow regulations, and coordinates access so the site remains safe for workers and occupants.
